faqKnowledgeBase.question: How does the Emergency Incident Auto-Routing system work?
faqKnowledgeBase.answer: When you report an incident with location and emergency category, NGO Connect uses a geodistance matching algorithm (Haversine formula) to locate the closest verified NGO specialized in that emergency. The NGO receives a priority dispatch notification with your GPS map pin and photo.

faqKnowledgeBase.question: Can I legally adopt a child directly through NGO Connect?
faqKnowledgeBase.answer: No. Child adoption in India is strictly governed by the Central Adoption Resource Authority (CARA) under the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act. NGO Connect functions strictly as a verified discovery and NGO inquiry window. All legal adoptions must be formally processed via the CARINGS portal (cara.wcd.gov.in) with authorized Specialised Adoption Agencies (SAAs).

faqKnowledgeBase.question: What is Elderly Sponsorship?
faqKnowledgeBase.answer: Elderly sponsorship allows compassionate citizens to sponsor monthly medical expenses, nutrition, and organize scheduled visits/companionship with senior citizens residing in verified old-age homes without complex legal proceedings.

faqKnowledgeBase.question: How does Anonymous Donation protect my identity?
faqKnowledgeBase.answer: By default, donations on NGO Connect are Anonymous. Your identity is encrypted and stored strictly for generating your 80G tax receipt and fraud prevention. Neither the NGO coordinators nor the public campaign feed will see your name or phone number unless you explicitly enable 'Show my name publicly'.

faqKnowledgeBase.question: How does NGO Connect verify NGOs and Orphanages?
faqKnowledgeBase.answer: Platform Administrators strictly verify government Darpan IDs, 12A/80G certificates, FCRA clearance, FCRA/Trust Deed registration, and on-ground track records before granting the Verified Green Checkmark.

faqKnowledgeBase.question: How does the QR Code volunteer check-in work?
faqKnowledgeBase.answer: Once you register for a drive and the NGO approves your slot, a digital QR Pass is generated in your app. When you arrive at the venue, the NGO coordinator scans your QR code on their device to instantaneously mark your attendance and credit your volunteer karma score.
